query: Summarize all the emails I've received about Raptor, including any deadlines.
answer:
I found **4 received emails about Raptor**, dated October 12–14, 2001. They focus on supporting the hedge valuations and responding to Arthur Andersen.

### Deadlines
**October 18, 2001** — two deliverables:
- Answers to Arthur Andersen’s **12 questions about the Raptor collars**.
- A **valuation memo** requested by Arthur Andersen; Mark Taylor asks whether your team can draft it.

### Email summaries
| Received | Sender / Subject | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| Oct. 14 | **Mark Taylor — “Raptor SPE structure - legal review”** | Legal needs your assessment of whether the hedge valuations are supportable. Includes **raptor_structure.pdf**, described as the current structure chart. Jeff Skilling is copied. No explicit deadline. |
| Oct. 14 | **Jeff Skilling — “Raptor hedge valuation”** | Requests your independent estimate of the credit-capacity shortfall in the Raptor hedges. He has heard figures around **$500 million**, but this is not a confirmed estimate. **Unread;** no explicit deadline. |
| Oct. 13 | **Mark Taylor — “Re: Raptor SPE structure - legal review”** | Asks your team to draft the valuation memo for Arthur Andersen, due **October 18**. |
| Oct. 12 | **Mark Taylor — “Raptor: Arthur Andersen questions”** | Says Andersen’s 12 questions on the Raptor collars have been forwarded to your team; answers are due **October 18**. |

*Excluded one matching email you sent, since you asked for received emails.*

**16 emails from 11 senders** · Dates below are in 2001. **High priority** reflects the email’s importance flag.

### EnronOnline System
- **Oct 15 — Trade confirmation #EOL-88213:** Confirmation for 10,000 MMBtu of Henry Hub natural gas, November delivery, at $2.41.

### Kenneth Lay
- **Oct 15 — All-employee meeting follow-up:** Requests a short note on how the research group supports trading. **High priority**
- **Oct 12 — Board meeting prep:** Prepare a nontechnical, one-page summary of market risk exposures for the October board meeting. **High priority**

### Sally Beck
- **Oct 14 — Risk Committee materials:** Attached meeting materials include the VaR summary and updated risk information.
- **Oct 13 — VaR model review schedule:** Annual review proposed for October 22–26; attachment included.
- **Sep 27 — Audit request: model inventory:** Send a complete inventory of production pricing models by month-end.

### GasBank Platform
- **Oct 14 — GasBank daily position alert:** Net long 4.2 Bcf across storage contracts; no limit breaches detected.
- **Oct 12 — GasBank: margin call warning:** NYMEX collateral requirement increased by $18 million; Treasury notified. **High priority**

### Jeff Skilling
- **Oct 14 — Raptor hedge valuation:** Requests your estimate of the Raptor hedges’ credit-capacity shortfall, citing figures around $500 million.

### Rebecca Mark
- **Oct 14 — Dynegy joint venture term sheet:** Attached draft terms for a weather-risk-products joint venture propose a 60/40 split.
- **Oct 13 — Re: Dynegy joint venture term sheet:** Requests comments on the valuation appendix ahead of the October 24 board meeting.

### Legal Ticketing
- **Oct 13 — Ticket LT-4480: URGENT compliance hold:** Document-retention hold issued for the trading analytics group; warns against deletion. **High priority**

### John Lavorato
- **Oct 13 — Gas volatility spike - need model run:** Gas implied volatility reached 85%; rerun storage valuation with the new volatility surface and send results. **High priority · Flagged**

### Zimin Lu
- **Oct 12 — Spread option pricing question:** Asks whether to use the Margrabe formula or two-factor Monte Carlo for spark spread options.

### Louise Kitchen
- **Oct 3 — EnronOnline analytics proposal:** Proposes a real-time order-flow analytics dashboard with a $400,000 budget estimate.

### Mark Taylor
- **Sep 20 — Contract template update:** Use the updated ISDA schedule template for all research-supported deals.

query: Get me ready for the Project Raptor Deep Dive: who's attending, what's still open in my Raptor backlog, and what the latest Raptor emails say.
answer:
## Project Raptor Deep Dive
**October 17, 2001 · 14:00–16:00 UTC · EB 50M**  
Purpose: Review Raptor collar valuations for Arthur Andersen.

### Who’s attending
- **Mark Taylor** — organizer
- **Jeff Skilling** — accepted
- **Stinson Gibner** — accepted
- **You** — RSVP still pending

All three listed attendees are required.

### Your Raptor backlog: 3 open items
| Task | Status | Priority | Due (UTC) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Raptor hedge MTM recalculation | In progress | **High** | Oct 16, 17:00 — before the meeting |
| Collect Andersen questions | Not started | Normal | Oct 18, 17:00 |
| Draft Raptor disclosure notes | Not started | Normal | Oct 22, 17:00 |

### What the latest Raptor emails say
- **Oct 14, 18:00 — Mark Taylor, “Raptor SPE structure - legal review”**  
  Legal needs your assessment of whether the hedge valuations are supportable. Mark attached **`raptor_structure.pdf`** and copied Jeff.
- **Oct 14, 08:00 — Jeff Skilling, “Raptor hedge valuation” — unread**  
  Jeff wants your independent estimate of the credit-capacity shortfall. He has heard **around $500 million**; that is a figure to validate, not a confirmed estimate.
- **Oct 13, 18:00 — Mark Taylor, legal-review follow-up**  
  Arthur Andersen wants the **valuation memo by October 18**. Mark asks whether your team can draft it.
- **Oct 12, 22:00 — Your sent email, “Raptor valuation assumptions”**  
  You sent Mark the collar valuation assumptions in **`raptor_assumptions.xls`**.
- **Oct 12, 18:00 — Mark Taylor, “Raptor: Arthur Andersen questions”**  
  Andersen submitted **12 questions** on the collars, forwarded to your team. **Answers are due October 18.**

### Recommended meeting focus
1. Bring the MTM recalculation and an independent shortfall estimate to address Jeff’s question.
2. Be ready to explain whether the valuations are supportable, using the structure chart and previously shared assumptions.
3. Agree on ownership for the **valuation memo and 12 Andersen answers**, both due the day after the meeting.

**Key mismatch:** Your backlog has “Collect Andersen questions” due October 18, but the email says the **answers** are due that day. The valuation memo also is not listed in your Raptor backlog.

*Attachment names are available, but I haven’t reviewed their contents.*

query: Before my 1:1 with Louise Kitchen, summarize what she's emailed me and any commitments I've made to her.
answer:
## Briefing for your 1:1 with Louise Kitchen
**October 16, 2001, 15:00–15:30 UTC · EB 30C1**  
Calendar agenda: **EnronOnline analytics and forward curves.**

I found **4 emails from Louise and 1 sent reply to her**.

### Your confirmed commitment
**Refresh the natural gas forward curves by Wednesday morning, October 17.**
- On **October 14**, Louise requested updated curves because traders saw a gap versus **NYMEX settlement prices**.
- You replied: “Louise, we will refresh the gas curves by Wednesday morning.”
- I found no email confirming completion.

### What she’s emailed you
| Date | Topic | Key points |
|---|---|---|
| **Oct 15** | Weekly EnronOnline volumes | **6,112 trades**, **$3.2 billion** notional value; gas products represented **58% of volume**. |
| **Oct 14** | Forward curve update | Requested refreshed natural gas curves by Wednesday to address the NYMEX pricing gap. |
| **Oct 13** | Bandwidth trading launch | Plans to launch **next month (November)**; asked Research to provide a **pricing methodology for bandwidth swaps**. No commitment from you found. |
| **Oct 3** | Analytics proposal | Proposed a **real-time order-flow analytics dashboard**, with a **$400,000 budget estimate**. This email is still **unread**; no approval or commitment from you found. |

### Suggested talking points
1. **Forward curves:** Give a progress update and confirm Wednesday morning delivery; explain how the NYMEX discrepancy is being addressed.
2. **Analytics dashboard:** Clarify scope, ownership, and whether the $400,000 estimate needs your review or approval.
3. **Bandwidth swaps:** Agree on Research’s role and a methodology deadline ahead of the November launch.

**Bottom line:** Your only explicit email commitment is the gas-curve refresh. The bandwidth methodology and analytics dashboard remain requests/proposals—not confirmed commitments.

query: What's the context for today's Gas Volatility Sync?
answer:
The **Gas Volatility Sync** is a follow-up on the jump in implied gas volatility and the resulting storage valuation model rerun.

**Meeting:** October 15, 2001, **17:00–17:45 UTC**, in **EB 3321**. John Lavorato is organizing; Zimin Lu has accepted. Your response is tentative.

### Background
- **October 13 — urgent request from John:** Implied gas volatility had jumped to **85%**. He asked you to rerun the storage valuation model using the new volatility surface and send results that day.
- **Your reply that morning:** You confirmed **Zimin was rerunning the model**, with results expected by **5 p.m.**
- **This morning — modeling assumptions:** Stinson Gibner proposed **50,000 Monte Carlo paths with antithetic variates**, and a mean-reversion speed estimated at **2.3 per year**. He copied Zimin and asked for your agreement.
- **Exposure context:** The October 14 GasBank alert reported a **net long position of 4.2 Bcf** across storage contracts, with **no limit breaches**.

**Likely focus:** Review the rerun’s valuation impact, confirm the simulation assumptions, and discuss implications for the storage position. I didn’t find completed rerun results in the related emails, so that’s the main item to confirm with Zimin.

query: Prep me for the FERC Compliance Review: who will be there and what deadlines matter?
answer:
## FERC Compliance Review
**October 16, 2001, 11:00–12:00 UTC · EB 47C1**  
Purpose: review the draft FERC market-behavior filing.

### Who will be there
- **Steven Kean — organizer**, VP & Chief of Staff. He requested your group’s price-formation analysis.
- **Richard Shapiro — accepted**, VP, Government Affairs. He was copied on the deadline request.
- **You — accepted.**

### Deadlines that matter
| Date | Deliverable |
|---|---|
| **October 16** | Compliance review of the draft filing. |
| **October 17** | Your group’s **price-formation analysis is due to Steven**, so Legal can review it. No cutoff time was specified. |
| **October 19** | **FERC quarterly market-behavior filing is due.** No cutoff time was specified. |

**Methodology requirement:** Steven’s October 13 correction says FERC staff confirmed that a model-methodology appendix is allowed; **keep the appendix under 10 pages**.

### What to prepare
Bring the draft filing and the current price-formation analysis. Be ready to identify outstanding work and confirm the Legal review handoff between October 17 and 19.

**Scheduling watch-outs:** Your calendar has FERC analysis focus time on **October 17, 09:00–12:00 UTC**—the delivery date itself. The review also overlaps with **Dynegy Partnership Review, October 16, 11:00–12:00 UTC**, which you have not responded to.

query: Prepare me for the Dynegy Credit Review: who's attending, and what have Dynegy people emailed me that's relevant to credit?
answer:
## Dynegy Credit Review
**October 20, 2001, 10:00–11:00 UTC · Dial-in**  
Agenda: Credit exposure review with Dynegy.

### Who’s attending
| Person | Organization | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **Tim Belden** — tim.belden@dynegy.com | Dynegy | Organizer |
| **Sally Beck** — sally.beck@enron.com | Enron | Accepted |

**Your RSVP is still pending.** These are the two people listed in the invitation.

### Relevant emails from Dynegy

**Direct credit request — highest priority**
- **Tim Belden · October 13 — “Credit exposure question”**  
  He asks for your group’s current estimate of **potential future exposure on long-dated power swaps**, adding: **“Credit wants a number above the 95th percentile.”**  
  **Prepare:** an exposure estimate and its assumptions; clarify exactly which percentile above 95% Credit requires. The email itself supplies no exposure number.

**Supporting valuation input**
- **Tim Belden · October 14 — “Western power price curves”**  
  Q1 2002 western power forward curves are in the shared drive; **Palo Verde peak is marked at $38.50/MWh**.  
  **Prepare:** confirm whether these curves should be used for the swap exposure calculation. There is no attachment to the email.

**Broader context—not explicit credit requests**
- **Rebecca Mark · October 14 — “Dynegy joint venture term sheet” — unread**  
  Proposed weather-risk-products JV: **60/40 split, with Dynegy the majority partner**. Attachment: `JV_term_sheet.docx`. The email body does not describe credit or collateral terms; the attachment’s contents were not available to review.
- **Rebecca Mark · October 13 — “Re: Dynegy joint venture term sheet” — unread**  
  Requests comments on the **valuation appendix before the October 24 board meeting**. Tim Belden is copied.

### Suggested focus for the call
Lead with **long-dated power-swap exposure**: the requested percentile, valuation curves, modeling assumptions, and resulting estimate. Keep the weather-risk JV valuation deadline as a secondary topic rather than treating it as an established credit issue.

query: For the project topics Raptor, FERC, and Dynegy: which topics have unread emails, and what meetings relate to those topics?
answer:
**Raptor and Dynegy have unread emails; FERC has none.** All times below are UTC, and all dates are in 2001.

### Unread emails
| Topic | Unread | Details |
|---|---:|---|
| Raptor | 1 | **“Raptor hedge valuation”** — Jeff Skilling, Oct 14 at 08:00 |
| FERC | 0 | All 4 matching emails are read. |
| Dynegy | 2 | **“Dynegy joint venture term sheet”** — Rebecca Mark, Oct 14 at 02:00; **“Re: Dynegy joint venture term sheet”** — Rebecca Mark, Oct 13 at 04:00 |

### Related meetings
| Topic | Meeting | Date and time (UTC) | Location | Organizer / your response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Raptor | Project Raptor Kick-off | Oct 8, 14:00–15:00 | EB 50M | Jeff Skilling / Accepted |
| Raptor | Project Raptor Deep Dive | Oct 17, 14:00–16:00 | EB 50M | Mark Taylor / Not responded |
| FERC | FERC Compliance Review | Oct 16, 11:00–12:00 | EB 47C1 | Steven Kean / Accepted |
| Dynegy | Dynegy Partnership Review | Oct 16, 11:00–12:00 | Dynegy HQ / dial-in | Rebecca Mark / Not responded |
| Dynegy | Dynegy Credit Review | Oct 20, 10:00–11:00 | Dial-in | Tim Belden / Not responded |

**Scheduling conflict:** FERC Compliance Review and Dynegy Partnership Review overlap completely on Oct 16, 11:00–12:00.

There is also a **FERC-related Focus Time block** on Oct 17, 09:00–12:00 for price-formation analysis; it is not a meeting.

query: Sally Beck proposed a window for the VaR model review, but I'm at the Energy Risk Conference for part of it. Schedule a 'VaR Model Review kickoff' on the first day of her window after the conference, 10:00-11:00 UTC, with Sally Beck and Stinson Gibner, then reply to her email with the time.
answer:
Scheduled **VaR Model Review kickoff** for **October 24, 2001, 10:00–11:00 UTC**, with **Sally Beck and Stinson Gibner**.

October 24 is the first day in Sally’s October 22–26 window after the Energy Risk Conference ends on October 23. I also replied to Sally’s email confirming the time.
